scope: Paired synthetic experiments. Not a production accuracy or availability benchmark.

method.replanning: Predictive and reactive re-evaluate after a 40s cooldown. Single-action control intervenes only once.
method.isolation: Isolation time is reported separately and counted in unavailable service-seconds; a healthy gateway does not imply every feature works.
method.predictive_trigger: Inferred origin plus a still-healthy exposed caller
method.reactive_trigger: Wait until the gateway is failed, then use the same planner
method.comparison: Same initial state and fixed per-tick physical random draws; logging uses a separate stream.
method.costs: Counts modelled failed time; assumed action downtime is used by the planner but is not added as an observed outage.
